source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: You can count 1 **Hit roll**, **Wound roll** or **saving throw** made for the bearer as an unmodified 6, right after rolling it. This works once per battle round. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.trigger: right after rolling a Hit, Wound or saving throw for the bearer

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Liberator Assault Group Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
